verdict.rationale: IRN Empresa Online is a government company-incorporation service: a web form, digital signing of the articles of association, payment and registration. Building user-defined automations that can be versioned, reviewed and rolled back is outside what this kind of product does, and nothing in the evidence shows it offers automations at all. The auto-generated pact document and the 5-day window to fix non-conformities are one-off filing steps, not automation version control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
